title: What is Artificial Intelligence?
description: An introduction to Artificial Intelligence for Grade 9 students. Covers the definition, key concepts, real-world applications, and common misconceptions about AI.
subject: Artificial Intelligence

concepts.name: Artificial Intelligence
concepts.description: The simulation of human intelligence by machines and computer systems

concepts.name: Machine Learning
concepts.description: A subset of AI where machines learn patterns from data without explicit programming

concepts.name: Neural Networks
concepts.description: Computing systems inspired by biological neural networks that process information in layers

concepts.name: Natural Language Processing
concepts.description: The ability of computers to understand, interpret, and generate human language

concepts.name: Computer Vision
concepts.description: The field of AI that enables machines to interpret and make decisions based on visual data

definitions.definition: Artificial Intelligence — the ability of machines to perform tasks that typically require human intelligence
A step-by-step procedure or set of rules for solving a problem
Facts, statistics, or information collected for analysis and reference
The dataset used to teach a machine learning model to make predictions
The process of using a trained model to make predictions on new data

examples.title: Smart Assistants
examples.description: Siri, Alexa, and Google Assistant use AI to understand voice commands, answer questions, and control smart home devices

examples.title: Recommendation Systems
examples.description: Netflix suggests movies, YouTube recommends videos, and Amazon shows products based on your past behavior and preferences

examples.title: Self-Driving Cars
examples.description: Autonomous vehicles use computer vision, sensor fusion, and decision-making algorithms to navigate roads safely

examples.title: Healthcare Diagnosis
examples.description: AI systems can analyze medical images like X-rays and MRIs to detect diseases with accuracy matching or exceeding human doctors

examples.title: Language Translation
examples.description: Google Translate and DeepL use neural networks to translate text between hundreds of languages in real time

misconceptions.belief: AI will replace all human jobs
misconceptions.correction: AI augments human capabilities and creates new job categories. It handles repetitive tasks while humans focus on creative and strategic work.

misconceptions.belief: AI is the same as robots
misconceptions.correction: AI is software that enables intelligence. Robots are physical machines that may or may not use AI. Not all AI is in robots, and not all robots use AI.

misconceptions.belief: AI can think and feel like humans
misconceptions.correction: AI processes data and makes decisions based on patterns, but it does not have consciousness, emotions, or genuine understanding like humans.

misconceptions.belief: AI is only for big tech companies
misconceptions.correction: AI tools and platforms are increasingly accessible. Students, small businesses, and educators can use AI through free tools and open-source libraries.

exercises.prompt: List three applications of AI that you use in your daily life. Explain how AI is involved in each one.
What is the difference between Artificial Intelligence and a regular computer program? Give an example of each.
You are designing an AI system to help farmers in Himachal Pradesh predict weather patterns. What data would you need? What challenges might you face?
True or False: Machine Learning is a type of Artificial Intelligence. Explain your answer.
exercises.solution: True. Machine Learning is a subset of AI that focuses on learning from data.

exercises.prompt: Draw a diagram showing the relationship between AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning. Label each part with a brief description.
